title: Add the missing document to change an appointment's status
summary: If the clinic requires a document for that status, the change is blocked: "Got it" opens the patient's details to add it and try again.

steps.title: Choose the status
steps.details: If the patient has no document and the clinic requires it for that status, the change is not made and the notice shows up.

steps.title: Got it
steps.details: Opens the patient's details (the same pencil as the appointment). "Close" only dismisses the notice.

steps.title: Save the patient's details
steps.details: Then change the appointment status again: it is no longer blocked.
